The '''Gilded Meteor''' was a prototype [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] that was developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was sent on its test flight in the [[Ferra sector/Legends|Ferra sector]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Battle above Hypori|attacked]] the bomber above [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], but was repelled.<ref name="Hypori Escort" />
